name: selvis-arts-craft-root
description: Selvi's Arts & Craft E-Commerce (Frontend, Backend, Database)

scripts.install-all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend/client && npm install --prefix frontend/admin && npm install --prefix database
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend/client && node -e "require('fs').cpSync('frontend/client/dist', 'dist', {recursive: true})"
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run backend" "npm run client" "npm run admin"
